## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ManagedDatabasesAndCaches`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `managed-databases`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ManagedDatabasesAndCaches**.

## Step 2: Register credentials

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [WSO2 Cloud Console](https://console.devant.dev/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Go to the WSO2 Cloud Console header and select your organization from the Organization list. -->
3. In the left navigation menu, select **Admin**.
4. Select **Databases**.
5. <!-- manual: Click on a required database to view its details. -->
6. Select **Databases**.
7. <!-- manual: Click to expand the database for which you want to register credentials, then click Add Credentials. -->
8. <!-- manual: In the Add Credentials dialog, do one of the following depending on your requirements: -->
9. - Select **Add New Credentials** and specify the following:
10. <!-- manual: Select Add New Credentials and specify the following: -->
11. A display name for the credentials.
12. The database credentials you created to use when setting up database connections in WSO2 Cloud.
13. The environment where you want to use the credentials.
14. - Select **Add Super Admin Credentials** and specify the following:
15. <!-- manual: Select Add Super Admin Credentials and specify the following: -->
16. A display name for the credentials.
17. The environment where you want to use the credentials.
18. Select **Save**.

## Step 3: Add the database or cache to the Marketplace

1. On the **Databases** tab, select **+ Add to Marketplace** corresponding to the database you want to add.
